newsitem.title: JAPAN: TOCOM to raise January rubber futures margin fee.
newsitem.headline: TOCOM to raise January rubber futures margin fee.

text.p: The Tokyo Commodity Exchange (TOCOM) said on Tuesday that it was raising the margin requirement on its January rubber futures contract by 10,000 yen per trading lot, effective from Wednesday.
The increase will bring the total January rubber requirement to 72,500 yen, TOCOM said in a statement.
The move is aimed at cooling overheated trade.
The requirement on other rubber futures contracts will be unchanged at 52,500 yen, TOCOM said.
